The '''Fifteenth Army''', also known as '''Hook Nebula Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Sarin Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Fifteenth [[Army/Legends|Army]] was envisioned as primarily a reserve force capable of enforcing [[Troop/Legends|troops]] seeing combat on the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], and [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
